pkgmetadata.longdescription: llama.cpp enables LLM inference with minimal setup and state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of hardware. It's a plain C/C++ implementation with no external dependencies, supporting various CPU instruction sets (AVX, AVX2, AVX512, ARM NEON), GPU backends (CUDA, Vulkan, OpenCL, ROCm), and multiple quantization formats.
